TEACHER_NAME,

I think its very important for all students here at Costa Mesa HS/MS to perform community service. I think its very important that students help out their community and the city. It will be great for extra credit and will show how responsible a student is. Their are many places in the cities that need help it will be great that all students take part in community service. One thing that i know will help from students getting in trouble with the law and joining gangs that will hurt their future. I hope that you will understand that community service should be part of the students live here at SCHOOL_NAME. And community service will bring strong and good impacts to the city of Costa Mesa.
